properties.name: Stripe
properties.gtm_one_liner: Financial infrastructure platform for accepting payments, running billing and subscriptions, and moving money globally, via APIs and no-code tools.
properties.gtm_industries_served: Fintech; Gaming; Hospitality, travel, and leisure; Insurance; Media and entertainment; Nonprofits; Professional services; Retail
properties.gtm_icp_fit_rationale: Stripe is a B2B software company with an enormous content engine (blog, guides, customer stories, gated reports, an annual conference, and video links), which matches the content-marketing profile. However, it is far beyond the 50-2000 employee mid-market band, has Fortune 100 enterprise procurement dynamics, and almost certainly runs video in-house, so realistic fit is limited.
properties.gtm_buying_signals: Sessions 2026 conference content promoted ('Building the economic infrastructure for AI', Watch now); Annual letter published: businesses on Stripe generated $1.9T in 2025; Crypto.com partnership announcement for crypto payments; New agentic commerce solutions / Agentic Commerce Protocol launch; Gated reports offered (Tidemark vertical SaaS benchmark, retailer growth report); Active hiring via careers page and sales chat with '7 sales reps available'
properties.gtm_disqualifiers: Company scale far exceeds the 50-2000 employee mid-market target; enterprise procurement; Likely already has in-house video/production and MarTech stack; Global consumer-scale platform, not a typical mid-market marketing buyer
properties.gtm_primary_cta: Start now / Create an account (with Contact sales secondary)

properties.name: Linear
properties.gtm_one_liner: Linear is a product development platform for planning, building, and shipping software, with AI agents built into the workflow.
properties.gtm_category: product development / issue tracking & project management software
properties.gtm_industries_served: Software / technology; Fintech; Real estate technology
properties.gtm_icp_fit_rationale: Linear is a clear B2B SaaS company with the right shape: pricing page, customer stories, changelog, blog/resources, self-serve signup plus contact sales, and named logos (OpenAI, Ramp, Opendoor). No evidence of embedded marketing video, gated content, or a marketing-automation-driven demand gen program on the homepage — the page is product-demo visuals rather than content marketing, and it may skew engineering-led rather than marketing-led.
properties.gtm_buying_signals: New product launch: 'Loops' announced on the homepage; Active changelog with frequent feature releases (Coding sessions, Team initiatives, Priority inbox); Careers page indicating hiring; Enterprise page and contact sales motion suggesting upmarket expansion; Customer stories program (OpenAI, Ramp, Opendoor) and 40,000 product teams scale
properties.gtm_disqualifiers: Marketing narrative is product/engineering-led; no visible video program or gated demand-gen content
properties.gtm_primary_cta: Get started (sign up), with secondary Contact sales

properties.name: Gong
properties.gtm_one_liner: Gong sells a Revenue AI operating system that captures and analyzes customer interactions to help GTM teams forecast, coach, and close deals.
properties.gtm_industries_served: Technology / SaaS; Financial services; Healthcare; Manufacturing
properties.gtm_icp_fit_rationale: Textbook B2B SaaS content-marketing machine: blog, Gong Labs research, resource library, customer stories, product tour, pricing page, demo form, and a flagship user conference — exactly the marketing org that buys video hosting. Score is capped because the copy skews enterprise (Fortune 10, 5,000+ customers, Google/LinkedIn/ADP logos) and there is no visible embedded video on the homepage itself.
properties.gtm_buying_signals: Hosting 'Celebrate '26' user conference Sept 29–Oct 1 in Las Vegas — event content/video production need; Careers page flagged 'We're hiring!'; Active blog cadence and Gong Labs research program; Recent product launches: Gong Agents, Gong Revenue Graph, Gong Collective; Ran a live panel webinar with G2 and HubSpot; Product tour and demo-led funnel with gated form
properties.gtm_disqualifiers: Enterprise-scale buyer (Fortune 10 references, 5,000+ customers) may mean heavy procurement; Large in-house marketing/AI org may build rather than buy

properties.name: Wistia
properties.gtm_one_liner: Wistia is a video marketing platform for businesses offering video hosting, webinars, recording/editing, lead-capture forms, and analytics that sync to marketing tools.
properties.gtm_icp_fit_rationale: Wistia is a direct competitor — it sells exactly the video hosting, analytics, and lead-capture platform we sell, including HubSpot/Marketo/Pardot integrations. Automatic disqualification regardless of otherwise strong content-marketing signals.
properties.gtm_disqualifiers: Direct competitor: video hosting and video marketing platform; Sells the same lead-capture, analytics, and marketing-automation video features we offer; Publishes competitive comparison content (Wistia vs Vimeo)
properties.gtm_primary_cta: Start a free trial / Sign up for free

properties.name: Notion
properties.gtm_one_liner: An AI-powered connected workspace for notes, docs, projects and knowledge management, with agents that automate team busywork.
properties.gtm_icp_fit_rationale: Notion is a B2B SaaS company with a full content marketing stack — blog, webinars, customer stories, academy, product tours — plus a self-serve free signup and a demo-led enterprise funnel, and a video player embedded on the homepage. Fit is capped because the proof points (62% of Fortune 100, 100M users, named enterprise logos like FedEx, Toyota, Nvidia) place it well above the 50–2000 employee mid-market band and imply enterprise procurement and likely in-house video tooling.
properties.gtm_buying_signals: Active webinar program linked in nav (webinars page); Customer stories library with named logos (OpenAI, Figma, Ramp, Cursor, Toyota); Video/product tours and demo content published on site ('Product tours', homepage video 'Play'); Dedicated Enterprise and Startups go-to-market pages plus 'Request a demo' contact-sales motion; New Custom Agents / AI product launch messaging and a 'What's New' releases page
properties.gtm_disqualifiers: Company scale far above mid-market ICP (100M users, 62% of Fortune 100) implying enterprise procurement; Likely large in-house marketing/creative stack already
